# LLM Agent Bug Study

All datasets used in this project are stored in the [Dataset](Dataset/) folder.

## Installation

1. Download and install **Redis** on your local machine.
2. Install the project dependencies:
   ```
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```

## Running the Agent

1. Start the Redis server:
   ```
   redis-server
   ```
2. Create a `.env` file and paste your API key there. (Options: `OPENAI_API_KEY` for GPT o3 mini, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` for Gemini 2.5 Flash, or `CLAUDE_API_KEY` for Claude Sonnet 4)
3. Prepare an input `.txt` file with the following format:
   ```
   title: Your post title here
   body:Your post body here (code, error trace, etc.)
   ```
4. Run the agent:

   **Print result to terminal (default):**
   ```
   python run_agent.py example.txt
   ```
   or explicitly:
   ```
   python run_agent.py example.txt 0
   ```

   **Write result to a text file:**
   ```
   python run_agent.py example.txt 1 output.txt
   ```

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `input_file` | Yes | Path to the input `.txt` file containing the Stack Overflow post |
| `output_mode` | No (default: `0`) | `0` = print to terminal, `1` = write to output file |
| `output_file` | Required when `output_mode` is `1` | Path to the output `.txt` file |

Both input and output files must be `.txt`. The script will exit with an error if:
- No input file is provided (`input file name missing`)
- Output mode is `1` but no output file is given (`output file name missing`)
- A non-`.txt` file is used for input or output

## Example

This repo includes `example.txt`, a sample Stack Overflow post. To run the agent on it and save the result to a file:

```
python run_agent.py example.txt 1 output.txt
```

This reads `example.txt`, runs bug analysis, and writes the JSON result to `output.txt`.

To print the result to the terminal instead:

```
python run_agent.py example.txt
```

## Notes

- Make sure Redis is running before starting the agent.
- All required Python packages are listed in `requirements.txt`.

**Note:** Claude Sonnet 4 was retired on June 15, 2026—after this project was submitted and rebuttaled ([Anthropic model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations)). If using `CLAUDE_API_KEY`, switch to any other available Anthropic model. The GPT and OpenRouter models used in this repo remain available as of August 10, 2026.

**Note:** Results not included in the manuscript due to page limits are available in [Out-of-paper-materials.pdf](Out-of-paper-materials.pdf) and on the [project website](https://sites.google.com/view/bugsinllmagents/home).
